position.definition: Maximum sampled world tip position error in the final interval.

speed.definition: Maximum sampled world tip translational speed norm in the final interval.

hypotheses.scope: Nominal case, seed 17, frozen offline_reach_hold_v1 acceptance and stable controller.gvs_nmpc@7.0.0; current campaign feedback only.
hypotheses.statement: The latest completed batch (d86d193) executed two fresh, valid, jointly accepted nominal seed17 candidates, but neither is established as componentwise non-worsening versus the retained incumbent: outcome0 (F702 0.0028147 m, F571 0.0030563 m, F566 0.0137373 m/s) and outcome1 (F524 0.0027190 m, F694 0.0028385 m, F588 0.0165220 m/s) are each higher than the incumbent's recorded 0.0026978 m, 0.0027301 m and 0.0127503 m/s on all three sampled physical metrics.
hypotheses.uncertainty: Identity-based incumbent comparison is classified unavailable because configuration/task identities differ; the comparison is descriptive against recorded incumbent values, one execution per configuration, no causal attribution and no continuous-time guarantee.

hypotheses.scope: Batch-d86d193, both outcomes, nominal seed17 only.
hypotheses.statement: Within the latest batch the two candidates trade off against each other rather than jointly improving: outcome1 records a smaller terminal error (F524 < F702) while recording a larger holding_max_speed than outcome0 (F588 > F566), so the admitted variation reproduces the historical speed-versus-position tradeoff instead of removing it.
hypotheses.uncertainty: Two single executions; no monotonicity, variance or causal claim; differences may reflect the changed near selector and/or weights rather than an isolated cause.
